scientific_scope: One ordinary-binary GF(2^61) fixture, two preselected B=316 bases, m=8 chained S3, two separately planted solver-positive controls, eight common known-answer subgroup targets and four raw channels per target. This is a bounded solver-to-certificate pilot, not a base superiority or end-to-end cost comparison.
readiness_note: Scientific schedule and resource limits are fixed here. Approval decision, frozen specification/plan hashes, executor task, dispatch queue, lawful lane and lintable runbook or implementation-tier reason remain absent. This draft must not be launched.

raw_archive_contract.archive_rule: The executor and isolated archive handoffs must declare all 13 exact files under each run ID for an output-validated stage. calls.tar.gz contains every dynamic calls/ file, including solver input, stdout, stderr, attempt.json, certificate.json and summary.json; calls-manifest.json hashes each member. The independent checker compares the bundle, manifest, on-disk tree, and raw-result digests before output validation. If the driver fails before packaging, preserve every available partial file and the adapter failure receipt in a separately declared correction/archive path; never relabel the failure as zero yield.

trials.watchdog_reason: Machine protection for each driver or checker process, above two internal 300-second solver call guards plus raw-tree packaging; the ECC campaign budget is uncapped.
trials.note: Weighted positive then local-random positive on separate planted targets. Both are required instrument controls; preserve each outcome, including censoring or invalidity. No natural solver call occurs in this stage.

trials.watchdog_reason: Machine protection for each driver or checker process, above the 25,200-second cumulative solver-call admission bound and final raw-tree packaging; the ECC campaign budget is uncapped.
trials.note: Require positive output_validated receipt and exact raw-result digest. The driver starts natural solver calls only if both positive point certificates pass; otherwise record a gated stage without natural solver work. At most 64 natural calls in fixed alternating base and channel order, each capped at 300 seconds, 8 GiB sampled solver RSS and 64 primary models.
